Priya: Quick kitchen PSA 1: the espresso machine has a weird squeal in the steam wand. If anyone uses it, please purge after frothing.
Zack: Noted. I'll bring a small towel to avoid the steam cloud. Also who wants lunch run? I've got time at 12:45.
Lina: Can you swing by the deli? Turkey club for me, and can we get 2 oat milks from the fridge restock bin? We're down to one.
Tom: Also chocolate-covered almonds in the stash are nearly gone. Can someone add to the snacks list?
Priya: Heads up: snack_shopping_list: [oat_milk x2, coffee_beans x1, paper_cups, chocolate_almonds].
SnackBot: Reminder set: "Restock fridge" at 15:00 today.
Zack: I'll pick up the deli + listed items. ETA 13:10. Cash or Venmo for deli?
Lina: Venmo is easiest. I'll send $11.
Tom: Thanks Zack! Also FYI let's try to write the date on open jars - peanut butter debacle was wild.
Priya: Agreed. I'm making some laminated labels tonight. Thanks everyone.
